messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing launch day cadence. We need eng to confirm the changelog URL + canary timing. Target announce Tue 09:00 PT. Any blockers?
adrian: I can confirm changelog link. Which doc set are we pointing to — release notes only or full migration guide too?
zoe: Put both. release-notes + migration-guide. I'll generate short anchor links and a single landing redirect.
maya: Perfect. Short marketing post will link to release-notes anchor, and a CTA to the migration guide. Can we get the exact URLs by EOD Fri?
adrian: Yes. I'll add a tiny changelog snippet and the canonical links to the repo.
adrian: changelog draft is in the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/release/changelog/2024-09-announce.md
adrian: We plan a staged canary: 30m canary at 09:00 PT -> ramp to 50% -> full at +2h if no errors. Ops will be on watch.
samir: Webinar host wants a 30s blurb in the announcement linking to registration page. We should include timezone conversions.
zoe: Note for docs: add a "what's new" callout with 3 bullets + link to webinar. I'll add the CTA anchor: /docs/#what-s-new-2024-09
maya: Inbound routing — need to wire marketing form -> sales SDR queue (EMEA vs NA split). Who owns the mapping?
adrian: @ops-bot can we add a header to the registration payload so Sales can route by region? e.g., X-Region: NA/EU/APAC
ops-bot: deploy-bot: routing flag added to staging form. See snippet: ```http
POST /register
Headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Region": "NA"}
Body: {"email": "...", "utm_campaign": "sep-announce"}
```
zoe: I'll add a short note in the docs for partners: "If you expect inbound >100/day, ping ops@redwood for special handling."
samir: Messaging iteration — can we get two subject lines to A/B test? Marketing will run for 24h after publish.
maya: Proposed subjects: 1) "Redwood Inference: faster, cheaper in prod" 2) "Ship reliable LLM inference — new canary tooling + docs" Pick one for primary, other as A.
adrian: Recommended canary checks: 5xx error rate <0.1%, median latency change <10%. If thresholds hit, auto-fallback to previous model.
zoe: I've updated the docs page; final links: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2024-09 and migration: https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/2024-09#notes
adrian: I'll drop the final changelog commit by 5pm PT today. Ops will schedule the canary window.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary: Tue 09:00 PT -> canary_end 09:30 PT, ramp 09:30-11:00 PT, full rollout 11:00 PT. Pager duty: eng-oncall -> adrian, eng-sre -> luna.
maya: Great. Last ask — marketing wants a single 2-line summary for the tweet/post and a short blurb for the blog header. Can someone drop them here by EOD?
adrian: 2-line summary: "Reduce LLM inference unit costs with smarter batching and KV cache; new canary rollout for safer updates. Read more: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2024-09"
zoe: Blog header blurb: "Today we’re launching targeted rollout tools and docs to make production inference safer and cheaper. Join our webinar for a demo: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/2024-09"
maya: Awesome — I'll assemble the assets and post the final schedule to the announce thread. Thanks everyone :rocket: 
adrian: 👍
samir: +1
zoe: :eyes:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reminder set for Tue 08:30 PT to start canary monitoring.
